background: Societe Generale is one of France's three largest banks, a universal bank with French retail networks, a large derivatives-driven investment bank, the Ayvens car-leasing business and banking subsidiaries in Africa and Central Europe.
synthesis: Ratings are A+ from Fitch after the upgrade on 12 May 2026, A from S&P on a positive outlook and A1 from Moody's on a negative outlook, so the agencies disagree on direction. The ratios are on the weak side of EU and Nordic peers across the board: CET1 of 13.2% and leverage of 4.3% are both in the bottom quarter, LCR of 146% is below the peer median and NSFR of 115% is in the bottom quarter. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods. The one flagged item, on 29 Jun 2026, is S&P's positive outlook. The weakest ratios of the large French banks held here.
